title: “Trust, not features, is the real deficit”: VMware tries to appease SMBs
summary: Broadcom admits it put “too big a focus on VCF.”
llm_summary: Broadcom has acknowledged that its heavy emphasis on VMware’s Cloud Foundation (VCF) missed the mark with small‑and‑medium businesses, which care more about reliable, trustworthy services than a long list of features. In response, VMware is shifting its messaging to stress simplicity, confidence and consistent performance, aiming to win back SMB customers who felt the product was overly complex and not aligned with their real‑world needs.
